projects.name: Zenergy Solar
projects.ownership: Confirmed: added instant estimates and CMS work, fixed UI/minor bugs and implemented client changes to a friend's existing site in a two-person team. On 2026-10-22 the user additionally confirmed personally adding AI review/classification of suspicious enquiry submissions containing fake email details, CAPTCHA and instant estimation. Do not claim all original website, analytics or search architecture.

additionalOwnershipConfirmation.source: Explicit user confirmation supplied in the active portfolio conversation; source inspection corroborates the implemented lead-quality, CAPTCHA and estimator paths.
additionalOwnershipConfirmation.scope: AI-assisted classification of suspicious contact-form submissions, CAPTCHA verification and instant estimation.
additionalOwnershipConfirmation.clientPurpose: Help the team distinguish suspicious or generated contact details before routine enquiry follow-up, while connecting property-based estimates and saved proposals with that same capture workflow.

facts.fact: The instant-roof estimator combines property/roof information, material and pitch choices with CMS-editable pricing to display tiered initial estimates. The source includes Google geocoding and Solar API building-mask/property measurement integrations.
Estimator results can be saved as UUID snapshots, rendered into a proposal PDF and included with the lead handoff. The client flow also requests scheduling slots and posts booking confirmation.
The custom Supabase CMS reads/writes cms_page_content sections and resolves server-rendered page sections. Estimator pricing is editable through this content model.

The site has server-side lead capture and an Enerflo forwarding integration. Contact/service forms submit through shared lead capture and mirror to Enerflo; production activation is not established by source inspection.

Lead capture verifies CAPTCHA before assessing submitted contact details. Rules inspect phone/name/address patterns, disposable/generated email indicators and DNS MX availability. Scores of 5 or more reject by rules; scores from 2 to 4 consult an optional AI classifier; lower scores pass. Rejected entries receive a validation response and are not forwarded by this capture route. Flagged entries are forwarded with a custom_spam_check warning.

The AI implementation calls OpenRouter chat completions with a configurable model and strict JSON-schema response containing looks_fake, confidence and reasons. It sends submitted name, email, phone, address and ZIP fields. A high-confidence fake verdict rejects; other fake verdicts flag; a not-fake verdict passes. Missing configuration, request failure or invalid output falls back to the rule-derived warning for borderline submissions. The request has an eight-second abort timeout.

The public verification UI is Google reCAPTCHA v2. The server posts fresh tokens to Google's siteverify endpoint, checks success and allowed hostname, and blocks missing or unavailable verification. Successfully verified users can receive an email-bound HMAC pass with a two-hour lifetime so the estimate wizard can reuse proof for later capture and booking steps without replaying a consumed CAPTCHA token.

The roof estimator prepares a saved snapshot and proposal PDF link, adds the estimate/property fields to the lead payload and submits through the shared CAPTCHA and quality-screened capture path. On capture failure it resets CAPTCHA and shows the returned error. Enerflo forwarding and completion tracking follow a successful capture response. This screening concerns the submitted enquiry details, not the arithmetic used to produce the estimate.

The layout mounts optional GA4/gtag and local-business JSON-LD. Public pages have descriptive/social metadata, while robots and sitemap support discovery. llms.txt and llms-full.txt supply a readable site index and expanded content for automated readers.
Google review components and a Google Places search/details route are implemented. Configuration and current production data were not inspected.
Media code supports direct browser-to-Backblaze B2 uploads with configurable CDN URLs and a media library. A separate utility-bill route also stores submitted files through B2.

limits: Existing analytics/reviews/search implementations are product capabilities unless separately confirmed as personal work.
AI screening evaluates submitted contact fields; it does not read an email inbox, classify message bodies, verify ownership of an email address or guarantee that a person is genuine.

The model is consulted only for borderline rule scores and depends on runtime configuration. Missing AI configuration or provider failures leave rule-based borderline cases flagged; CAPTCHA verification failures instead block submission.
DNS MX checks indicate mail-server availability, not mailbox existence or deliverability. DNS timeouts and unusual DNS errors fail open.
No measured spam reduction, false-positive rate, classification accuracy or claim that all fake emails are blocked is established.
The quality check is implemented on the shared lead-capture route; do not imply every standalone route applies the AI classifier.
No Payload CMS evidence identified.
llms.txt is an optional machine-readable content route, not proof of AI inclusion, ranking or an official ranking requirement.
Do not claim guaranteed quote accuracy, realized energy savings, top visibility, traffic or conversion lift.
